items.exampleEn: The baby is playing with a toy.
She wrote a poem for her mother.
We are going to a concert tonight.
items.exampleZh: 我們今晚要去聽音樂會。

items.exampleEn: We have drama class on Friday.
My favorite singer has a new album.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的歌手出了新專輯。

items.exampleEn: My son can swim very well.

items.audioEn: The concert starts at eight. The singer is very famous.
items.audioZh: 演唱會八點開始，那位歌手很有名。

items.sentenceEn: My son has a lot of toys.
Can you read this poem for us?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以為我們朗讀這首詩嗎？

items.stemEn: This singer has a new ____ with ten songs.
items.stemZh: 這位歌手出了一張有十首歌的新專輯。

items.stemEn: It is hot. Let's go for a ____ in the sea.
items.stemZh: 好熱，我們去海裡游泳吧。

items.passageEn: Emma loves music and drama. She sings pop songs, and she writes poems. Her favorite singer has a concert in Taipei this Saturday. Emma has a ticket! She will take her pink photo album to the concert. Maybe the singer will write something in it.
items.passageZh: Emma 很喜歡音樂和戲劇。她會唱流行歌，也會寫詩。她最喜歡的歌手這個星期六在台北開演唱會，Emma 有票！她會帶著粉紅色的相簿去演唱會，也許歌手會在上面寫幾句話。

questions.questionZh: Emma 最喜歡的歌手在哪裡開演唱會？
Emma 會帶什麼去演唱會？

referenceEn: I like to listen to pop music.
I like listening to pop music.
rubricZh: 「聽音樂」用 listen to music（要有 to）

items.instructionZh: 用 singer 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的歌手。
referenceEn: My favorite singer is from Korea.
rubricZh: 可用 My favorite singer is…，或 … is a great singer 等
